changelog: 🛠️ CI Build Fix & Proprietary Licensing: Fixed Kotlin compilation errors in ChatScreen when resolving model display names for DeepSeek Harness. Transitioned project license to proprietary copyright notice.

🛠️ Terminal Environment & Startup Fixes: Resolved Permission Denied when opening dpkg configuration directory and missing zsh function definitions (add-zsh-hook, vcs_info, is-at-least) by injecting LD_PRELOAD (libtermux-exec.so), DPKG_ADMINDIR, and dynamic FPATH discovery into terminal and command execution sessions under com.antibot.

⚡ Antigravity Hub Resilient Fallback & Isolated Multi-Agent Errors: Replaced hard 10s timeout blocking on absent Antigravity Hub with resilient fallback to local IDE bridge /api/conversations. Emitted instant hub_status over WebSocket, preventing startup hangs. Isolated conversation errors by active agent backend so DeepSeek Harness, Claude, Codex, and OpenCode remain fully responsive even when Antigravity Hub is offline.

✨ DeepSeek Harness Input Dock Integration & Cached Model Purge: Fully wired isDshChat into ChatScreen (model pill resolution, ChatInputBar send permission, and greeting prompt card) and thoroughly purged legacy 'Auto (Smart LLM Manager)' cached strings across AiModel.findInList and AuthPreferences.

🛡️ Dynamic Model Selector, CLI Auto-Startup & Scaled Local Intelligence: Removed hardcoded fallback model names (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, etc.) for unauthenticated CLIs in the Model Selector bottom sheet, replacing them with live authentication status and 1-tap sign-in / sync prompts. Implemented /api/claude/status, /info, /sessions, and /providers routes in the native Rust daemon (agy_ide_bridge_rs) to correctly detect Claude CLI installation and authentication state. Fixed cold-start hang on "Checking... Starting... waiting for the server" by auto-initializing codexBackend.start(), openCodeBackend.start(), and claudeAccount.refreshStatus() in ChatViewModel.init alongside a lifecycle server status observer. Enhanced Local Model with context-aware conversational reasoning, dynamic greeting handling, and parameter-scaled streaming delay & chunk sizing (4B vs 1.5B vs 0.5B) to realistically reflect on-device inference compute overhead.

🧹 Codebase Modernization, CI Fixes & Legacy Bloat Removal: Fixed CI compilation issues (destructuring component6 in LocalIntelligenceEngine, JSON_MEDIA_TYPE in IdeApiClient, and Collection<AgentKind> in ModelSelectorBottomSheet / ChatScreen). Streamlined codebase by removing obsolete legacy UI components (AgentTopBarDropdown, ClaudeModelSheet, OpenCodeModelSheet, SummaryModelPickerDialog, SpeechToTextModeDialog, FloatingTerminalInspector), completely eliminating the 1,484-line video player subsystem in favor of lightweight native video intents, and retiring the legacy Go bridge directory (agy_ide_bridge/) in full transition to the high-performance native Rust daemon (agy_ide_bridge_rs) with 67/67 passing tests.

🚀 DeepSeek Harness Autonomous Goal Runner & Cross-CLI Milestone Ledger: Ported DeepSeek Harness's packages/goal milestone ledger, verifiers, and checkpoint persistence to AntiBot. Added /goal runner in the Rust bridge daemon (POST /api/goal/start, /step, /pause, /resume, /list, /:id) with automatic multi-CLI delegation (assigning milestones across Claude Code for audit, Gemini for implementation, and Local Qwen for verification). Added automatic self-healing rate-limit failovers during goal milestones and durable checkpoint storage (~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/goals/<id>.json) for cross-session resumption. Added Subagent execution timeline visualization in Claude-style background work summary with violet accent icons and normalized tool parsing. Updated Kotlin IdeApiClient with startGoal, stepGoal, pauseGoal, resumeGoal, and getGoal RPCs.

⚡ Unified Multi-CLI Model Selector, Cross-Engine Subagents & Self-Healing Failover: Replaced the redundant top-bar agent selector with a unified Multi-CLI Model Selector directly inside the chat input dock, maximizing screen real estate and organizing models across Antigravity (Gemini), Claude Code, Codex, On-Device Local Qwen, and OpenCode with 1-tap switching and dynamic family branding. Added cross-CLI subagent dispatch engine (POST /api/subagents/invoke) in the Rust bridge with granular intra-CLI model targeting (Haiku vs Sonnet vs Flash vs Pro) and live quota matrix awareness. Implemented automatic self-healing rate-limit failover: intercepting HTTP 429 quota exhaustion errors during subagent workflows and seamlessly transferring incomplete tasks to the next available AI engine without user interruption or data loss. Maintained independent 1-by-1 login and logout across all CLIs with zero conversation history erasure upon sign-out.

🛡️ Zero-Permission Skills Engine & Resilient Multi-Storage: Resolved permission denied (EACCES) when installing skills or skill bundles from the Skills Hub. Implemented a resilient multi-storage architecture prioritizing app-internal private storage (appContext.filesDir/skills) with zero Linux DAC permission barriers. Added dual-channel background synchronization to Termux CLI environments (Antigravity, Local Model, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) via bridge RPC (POST /api/skills/install) and IdeApiClient.saveFile. Added support for 'universal', 'local', and 'antibot' targets across Go and Rust bridge handlers, multi-path discovery fallback, curated offline bundle list, and seamless skill re-syncing.

⚡ Mid-Chat CLI Switching & Slash Commands (/plan, /boost): Added seamless in-chat CLI agent switching (Antigravity, Local Qwen, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) with an interactive dialog allowing users to switch active engines either directly within the ongoing conversation—preserving all messages, files, and context—or start fresh. Enforced strict Zero-Idle-RAM memory unloading when switching away from local models. Added native support for /plan (architectural breakdown, trade-off matrix, atomic checklists) and /boost (deep cognitive reasoning trace, first-principles synthesis) across slash commands, local intelligence engine, and prompt expansion. Enhanced local model code generation with full visible markdown code blocks directly in chat and progressive simulated thought streaming.

🎨 Prompt-Aware Dynamic 3D Web Generation & UI Preview Cleanup: Fixed local model code generation always outputting static hardcoded Alex Vance templates. Implemented dynamic, prompt-aware generation engine: synthesizing interactive 3D WebGL rotating polyhedron meshes with inertia drag damping, real-time CSS 3D card tilt with specular light reflection, fluid keyframe animations & transitions, full interactive To-Do apps (todo.html) with localStorage persistence & filter tabs, executive metrics dashboards with canvas area charts, SaaS landing pages with pricing switchers, and touch-ready cyberpunk arcade games. Cleaned up preview UI redundancy by eliminating the floating WebPreviewBanner popup above the chat input dock and suppressing duplicate preview cards in chat messages when Claude-style Artifact cards are present. Added seamless 'Open in Inbuilt Browser' navigation directly from the Artifact Viewer.

🔬 NSA Ghidra Decompiler & REA Engine Integration: Fully integrated the official NSA Ghidra decompiler and reverse engineering framework (v11.2.1) directly into AntiBot and the REA toolchain on device. Compiled the native Linux ARM64 decompiler sled (ghidra_opt -> decompile) with native C++ execution inside the proot Ubuntu container. Added 1-click Ghidra installation in Settings → REA, automated CLI wrappers (ghidra-decompiler, ghidra-analyze, analyzeHeadless), enabled Ghidra decompiler session tools (open_binary, analyze_function, procedure_pseudo_code, batch_decompile, decompile_all), and enhanced rea_ghidra_decompile_handler in the Rust bridge daemon with dynamic multi-path rootfs resolution.

✨ Claude-Style Background Work Summary & Interactive Artifact Viewer: Background steps (thinking, skill lookups, file creation, tool executions) are now cleanly summarized in a compact single-line summary row ('•• Planning...' while running, '⏱️ Checking...' when done) matching the Claude Android app. Tapping opens a sleek Summary Bottom Sheet with a connected timeline of steps and detail logs, drastically reducing chat feed lag and memory load. Generated HTML, web apps, and code scripts are showcased in interactive Artifact Cards with 1-click live preview (HTML5/Canvas WebGL), syntax-highlighted Code view, and instant Inbuilt Browser integration. Fixed on-demand remote skill installation from GitHub and resolved RECOMMENDED badge UI wrapping in TargetPickerModal.

🛡️ Zero-RAM Idle Standby & On-Demand Engine Activation: Implemented strict zero-idle-RAM policy for all local neural models (Qwen 0.5B, 1.5B, 2B, 3B, 4B) and multi-CLI engines. Local models only load into memory when actively performing a task and immediately unload (0 MB RAM load) upon completion or when switched away. In Manager Mode, SmartManagerOrchestrator ensures turn-based lazy activation: only the specific engine selected for work starts, while all other CLIs and local models stay completely inactive on standby. Added live Zero-RAM Standby monitors in Settings and dynamic memory status indicators in Model Selector.

🌐 1-Click In-Chat Live Web Preview: Added instant 1-click on-screen preview for generated HTML webpages, portfolios, web apps, and local dev servers. Assistant messages now feature an interactive '🌐 Live Output Preview' card with direct preview actions. Added LiveWebPreviewDialog with full HTML5/JavaScript/CSS 3D canvas rendering directly on your screen without leaving the chat, 'Open in Inbuilt Browser' integration, and a sticky WebPreviewBanner above the chat input to re-open active web projects at any time. Replaced confusing terminal commands with direct 1-click preview links.

🧠 Qwen 3.5 Local Models Upgrade & 2B, 3B, 4B Models: Upgraded local on-device neural engine suite to Qwen 3.5 architecture across all model tiers. Added 1-click on-demand installation for Qwen 3.5 Coder 2B (~1.28GB), 3B (~2.10GB), and 4B (~2.74GB) models alongside 0.5B (built-in ultra-fast default) and 1.5B (1B tier). All large models remain downloadable on-demand with live progress tracking, cancel/delete storage controls, zero cloud tokens, and backwards compatibility with existing downloaded weights.

🧠 1-Click Installable 1B Local Model & Universal Multi-Engine Skills: Added 1-click on-demand download for Qwen 2.5 Coder 1.5B (1B model, ~986MB GGUF) with live download progress tracking, cancel/delete storage controls, and zero cloud tokens. Added '🌟 Universal (All Models & CLIs)' and '🧠 Local Model' targets in Skills Hub: any installed skill is immediately accessible across Local AI, Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode without needing duplicate installs.

🔄 Skills Library Updates & Claude 3.5 Sonnet Fix: Corrected model reference from Claude 3.7 to Claude 3.5 Sonnet across all Smart Manager CLI and Model selectors. Added live Skills Update detection and sync with remote repository (https://github.com/sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills.git): automatic HEAD check, Update Available banner with 1-tap update, header sync button with badge, Re-sync All Installed Skills action in Installed tab, and in-chat natural commands ('update skills', 'check skills update').

🧠 Smart Manager Brain (Qwen 3.5 Coder On-Device Neural Engine) & Multi-CLI Switcher: Upgraded Smart LLM Manager with on-device Qwen 3.5 Coder 0.5B neural model as the primary routing brain (<15ms zero-latency intent classification, 0 cloud tokens). Added full support for selecting, switching, and setting defaults across all 5 CLI engines (Antigravity, Local Qwen, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode). Categorized task routing dialog into dedicated CLI Manager and Cloud Model sections, added interactive CLI switcher cards, real-time brain metrics, and preferred CLI auto-dispatch.

🧠 Agentic Awesome Skills (2,955+ Skills & 30 Bundles): Full native integration of the entire Agentic Awesome Skills library across all AIs and CLIs. Features an interactive Skills Hub dialog with live search, category/risk filter chips, and 1-tap installation into projects (.agents/skills) or globally. Added agentic_skills_mcp local bridge MCP server, in-chat AI skill commands ('search skills', 'install skill', 'install bundle', 'list skills'), and 1-tap presets in General MCP, Codex, OpenCode, and Claude Code settings.

🕒 Offline GitHub-Style Local Version Control: Full local version control suite working completely without GitHub. Features an interactive Version Control Dialog with visual commit timeline cards, file additions/deletions diff viewer, 1-tap workspace rollback/revert, file-level restoration, branch manager, and in-chat natural AI commands ('save checkpoint', 'rollback', 'show version history'). Available everywhere across Top Bar, IDE Git tab, and Chat.

📁 Move Chat to Project & UI/UX Polish: Added one-tap 'Move Chat to Project' dialog and in-chat AI intent detection to export full conversation context into structured PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, docs/CONVERSATION_HISTORY.md, and AGENTS.md workspaces. Fixed top bar header text truncation and refined agent dropdown layout.

🔧 Fix CI Build & Committer Attribution: Resolved Kotlin OkHttp compilation deprecation errors in NetworkInspectorManager and TrajectoryParser, fixed filterOptions type inference in ChatHistoryDrawer, and attributed CI auto-sync commits to onebotyt instead of github-actions[bot].

⚡ Multi-CLI Agent Persistence & Top Corner Dropdown: Fixed AgentPreferences to properly persist and restore all chosen CLI agents across app restarts (Antigravity, Local, Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex). Replaced home screen agent pill with a sleek top-corner dropdown selector for instant switching between CLI agents.

🦀 Rust Transcript Metadata API: Added GET /api/conversations/:id/meta to the Rust bridge daemon, providing instant memory-mapped extraction of chat titles, total steps count, execution status, first prompt, and last active role. Supported in IdeApiClient.getConversationMeta().

🦀 Rust Local Intelligence Intent Classifier: On-device prompt intent classification (direct shell commands, dev servers, browser search, dev team pipelines, web generation, and greeting/identity) is now ported to the Rust bridge daemon via POST /api/ai/intent/classify. LocalIntelligenceEngine delegates with seamless local fallback.

🦀 Rust Archive Engine: IdeApiClient now connects directly to the Rust bridge archive engine for chat backups (POST /api/backup/chats), chat restores (POST /api/restore/chats), project workspace backups (POST /api/backup/projects), and project restores (POST /api/restore/projects).

🦀 Rust Network Traffic Inspector: Unified Android NetworkInspectorManager with the Rust bridge TrafficInspector (POST /api/network/record & GET /api/network/stats) for real-time bandwidth (upload/download bps), active connections, and latency tracking in native code.

🦀 Rust TrajectoryParser: Cortex/AGY step trajectory parsing is now ported to the Rust bridge daemon via POST /api/conversations/parse-trajectory with unified tool name normalization, thought parsing, and structured ChatMessage extraction. Kotlin TrajectoryParser delegates seamlessly with local fallback.

🦀 Rust SHA-256 for File Save & Patch: File save (POST /api/file/save) and file patch (POST /api/file/patch) now compute and return SHA-256 hashes directly in Rust via antibot_native crypto engine, removing client-side SHA-256 recalculation in IdeApiClient.

🦀 Rust ContextCompactor: Chat history compaction, summarization prompt construction, anchor rule loading (AGENTS.md, .gemini/rules, CLAUDE.md), and rollover seed prompts are now ported to the Rust bridge daemon (POST /api/conversations/compact and POST /api/conversations/rollover-seed). Kotlin delegates seamlessly with local fallback.

🦀 Rust SmartModelRouter: AI model routing is now handled by the Rust bridge daemon via POST /api/models/route — 8-step priority chain (manual → offline → shell → security → coding → fast-QA → fallback → local), with Kotlin routeViaBridge() falling back gracefully when daemon unavailable.
